skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray with diffuse interstitial abnormalities to distinguish fibrotic patterns from other causes of lung opacity.
steps: Inspect the lung parenchyma for a reticular (net-like) pattern of linear opacities.
Assess the vertical distribution of the reticulation; confirm if it is predominantly located in the lower lung zones/bases.

Systematically exclude alternatives: verify absence of focal lobar consolidation (pneumonia), visible pleural line with absent peripheral markings (pneumothorax), and significant cardiomegaly with vascular redistribution (heart failure).
